scopeReview.reviewMethod: AI-assisted visual scope screening; not expert-validated botanical labels
scopeReview.notes: AI-assisted visual scope screening of all 1000 collected candidates on 20 numbered sheets, with 17 full-size checks; 995 retained and 5 excluded for uncertain species/scope or an unidentifiable dark/texture image. No model predictions were viewed or used in selection. User confirmed no use for training, threshold tuning, temperature fitting or checkpoint selection. All supplied byte/decoded/perceptual identities matched; no exact or phash-distance<=5 matches against 5160 supplied training-manifest photos. Publisher author profiles are recorded where available, but historical source/capture provenance is unknown and full independence is not proven. This is AI-assisted screening, not expert-validated botanical ground truth or field accuracy evidence.

pairedMango.role: Exploratory paired comparison on the same historical397 study images, not independently collected field accuracy.
pairedMango.calibrationLimit: NLL, Brier and ten-bin ECE recomputed on historical397 for description only; not a new temperature fit or proof of field calibration. ECE depends on binning.

No V4.5 predictions on locked995 were supplied.

visualReview.conclusion: The accepted set includes clearly unrelated animals, people, shoes, artwork/documents and scenes. Broad confident unsupported-image acceptance persists; these observations do not prove which learned features caused it.

archiveRecommendations: Copy selected immutable source files into artifacts/training and artifacts/evaluation while preserving original relative paths and original completion receipts; keep original source runs unchanged.

Copy source PNG figures into figures/training. Keep original evaluation contact sheets under figures/evaluation/fresh_ood_review; current contact sheets are derived post-report error-review material and belong under a separately identified review folder.
Record all selected-copy relative destinations and original source hashes in a new archive provenance manifest. An omitted source file must be identified as omitted; do not rewrite original receipts.
Keep full Keras weights and raw image pools out of public/model. public/model should contain the exported TFJS graph, referenced weight shards and compatible model_config.json only.

Before local candidate installation, save a complete hash-verified copy of current V4.5 public/model and the active model version/preprocessing/gate settings. Test rollback by checksum. Mark V5 as a local candidate, not adopted or deployed.
Preserve executed notebooks including their outputs and original notebook filenames/identities; if renaming the Reults typo, record the original name/hash separately and update links.
